caption: Kar. 61. Stela (Kar. Cem., Pl. 18, No. 7100)
reading: wosi : soreyi : kdiqo : are(2)kñḫetoqowi : p?edeqye : te(3)dḫelowi : teter : s?np?t : terikelowi : pesetol : yenmdelo(5)wi : teter : s?np?t : semlowi : (6)ẖlo : mrtowi : atomẖe : psi(7)sekese : atmẖe : psiḫrke(8)se : ḫmlol : qlase : ḫlẖl : (9)yetḫase : nseñoal : ñole (10)yiñoteñiyease :
notes: No line number 4 seen in the copy. 'teter : s?np?t :' is copied twice (lines 3 and 5). The sign read q (slash+3) in kdiqo, -qowi, qlase could be o+s. In s?np?t the first sign is a plain 3 (s/m/ẖ) and the third a zigzag-topped sign with long tail (p or k). In p?edeqye the first sign is long-tailed (p or k) and the strokes before the last e are read as y (three strokes). 'a' (S+2) vs e+long-tailed sign: read a in are-, atomẖe, qlase, ḫase, ease. The crossed-loop sign is read ñ (not d) throughout; the loop-with-tail sign is read d. In the 3-shaped pairs after ato/at I read m then ẖ.

caption: Kar. 62. Altar
labels: sic, by line 4 (over the sign before the first tedḫelowi)
reading: wosi : (2)soreyi : meti(3)tbrsqowi : [.]il(4)smli : d?tedḫelowi : tedḫelowi (5)ñ?[.]kretritri : te(6)rikel(7)owi : a(8)to?mẖe : (9)psomte : (10)atmẖe psḫrkte :
notes: tedḫelowi is copied twice; the first carries 'sic' over a loop sign before te (read d?). The sign before (4) in the mother's name is hatched and lost. In ato?mẖe the second sign is drawn as a plain c (ḫ form) not the dotted to; read to? from the formula. The hatched sign after ñ? in line 5 has some strokes but I cannot read it. m in the first name is the ')' form; '·3' after (3) read as t.

caption: Kar. 63. Altar
notes: No word dividers in this copy except one hatched dotted spot before te at the end. Hatching after wo- is about two signs wide and a small one before -oreyi one sign (presumably si : so). The S of the a in (4)ato is partly hatched. The k before the last te is partly hatched, and the small hatched sign after it is unreadable (e expected).

caption: Kar. 64. Altar (Kar. Cem., Pl. 17. No. 7098)
reading: wosi : a(2)soreyi : qo : (3)reqorelowi [.][.]e?tmdeqe(4)se : qorelkrqowi : arkiye : (5)tedḫlebkwi : ñ?wkr : teri(6)kel[.]ebkwi : (7)ato[.](8)ẖe pso(9)ẖebḫte : (10)atmẖe[.]psḫrbḫte : (11)ḫmlolpsolbḫte : pese(12)tol yetmdelebkwi : (13)t?lidw(14)seqowi (15)semte?wi : (16)sitleye : ted(17)ḫlowi : nsetr : (18)terikelowi : a(19)to?mẖe : p(20)somte : (21)atmẖe psḫr(22)kete : ḫ[.]lol pso(23)lkete : wosi a(24)soreyi :
notes: Line 3 has a hatched stretch (about two signs) before e?tmde (yetmde expected). The ∠-shaped sign before k in -bkwi and before ḫte is read b (could be n, 'ʌ with long tail'). tedḫ- is written without e in lines 5 and 17. In a(19)to?mẖe the to is a plain c form (cf. Kar. 62). 'pso' could be 'pq' (slash+3). (13) first sign is ϟ-like with a cross stroke, read t?. -te?wi in line 15: ϟ with a bar (te) vs o+l. The hatched sign in ḫ[.]lol (line 23) is presumably m. A second invocation wosi a(24)soreyi closes the text.

caption: Kar. 65. Stela
reading: wosi : soreyi : m(2)liwites?omeqo(3)wi : ḫrye : tedḫe(4)lowi : skliye teri(5)kelowi : ato?mḫe pso(6)mekete : atmḫe p(7)siḫrkete :
notes: The divider before ḫrye is a single dot in the copy. The to in ato? is hatched beneath. Here mḫe is written with the c-form ḫ, unlike the 3-shaped sign in the other texts. In skliye the first sign is a plain 3 (s/m/ẖ) and the y is three strokes.

caption: Kar. 66. Altar
labels: fault?, by line 3 (over the hatched area)
sic, by line 5 (over the second sign of at?mẖe)
notes: After sore- the copy shows the se form (ʋ//), not yi. The hatched stretch marked 'fault?' is about two signs wide; it may be a fault in the stone rather than lost signs. The second 3 after it has a dotted tail. 'sic' stands over the dotted ϟ before m in the second benediction (t, or the S of a).
